specs.title: STEP8-DRAG-1000: real gutter drag retains every block and reports browser frame timing
STEP8-DRAG-PREVIEW: held block floats, siblings make space, drop and cancellation retain the document
STEP8-DRAG-REMOTE: a real peer edit cancels the stale drag without inserting its text
STEP8-DRAG-DOWN: a multiline block opens a full-height gap, reduced motion and outside drop preserve content
STEP8-DRAG-GUTTER: vertical movement in the handle column drops without entering the text
